verdict.rationale: Zamzar offers a documented REST API with a Java SDK and code samples, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows a published OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) all returned 404. The SDK and code samples are adjacent features and earn no credit toward a machine-readable spec.
